biotools.summary: Rodin is a Python-based tool for streamlined metabolomics data analysis and visualization, offering a web interface or programming library for fast and efficient processing of large datasets. It integrates multiple stages of analysis, including preprocessing, statistical testing, and pathway analysis, enhancing accessibility and throughput for users of all skill levels.
